law: ONE operator surface (START/STOP/STATUS/SAFE_HALT/RESUME); dependency-aware boot; idempotent runs; append-only run-ledger; resume-from-ledger never restart-blind; no fabricated health — a component without a probe result is UNKNOWN, never READY
terminal_status_rule: any CRITICAL component failed => SAFE_HALT; else any NON_CRITICAL or ADVISORY component failed/degraded => SYSTEM_DEGRADED; else SYSTEM_ONLINE; OPTIONAL components never affect status

run_record_fields.run_id: string, sha-derived, unique per accepted start
run_record_fields.idempotency_key: string sha256(config_sha + registry_sha + intent); identical repeat start returns the existing run
run_record_fields.config_sha: sha256 of loaded control plane config
run_record_fields.evidence: array of ledger row refs / probe ids

ledger_laws.resume: inspect durable state -> last completed phase per component -> resume; NEVER blind restart
ledger_laws.locks: single active run; crash => stale lock detected via heartbeat age; steal requires explicit SAFE_HALT record
ledger_laws.replayability: same config + same injected health results => same phase sequence (deterministic given inputs)
